name: Interval Fist
description: Strike with a fist timed to the exact interval between the foe's last two blows.

name: Interval Cover
description: Cover the body in the gap between one blow and the next that the memory has already marked.

name: Interval Gauge
description: Gauge how long a past event lasted and how soon its like will come again.

name: Cadenced Pace
description: Move on the remembered cadence of the foe's attacks and land between them.

name: Interval Prompt
description: Prompt an ally at the exact interval where the ally's response will land best.

name: Interval Mending
description: Mend the lost minutes in an ally's mind by laying the true span of them back in place.

name: Interval Haze
description: Smear the foe's sense of how much time has passed so the foe mistimes every blow.

name: Interval Replay
description: Replay the last few intervals of the fight to catch the pattern in the foe's timing.

name: Replayed Strike
description: Strike the same blow a second time just after the first so the foe is hit twice for one swing.

name: Interval Ward
description: Hold a ward in which a blow already remembered fails to land a second time.

name: Interval Recoil
description: Throw a blow back along the memory of the moment it was struck and return it to the striker.

name: Moment Returned
description: streams: Memory + Time; call a remembered moment back into the present so that a blow already struck lands again with all its original force on a foe who thought it done.

name: Nocturne Fist
description: Strike with a fist that arrives like a half-remembered dream and is gone before the foe wakes to it.

name: Nocturne Cover
description: Draw a soft dark cover of remembered night round the body to turn the first strike.

name: Nocturne Sense
description: Read the dreams and memories that cling to a sleeper or a sleeping place.

name: Nocturne Tread
description: Tread as softly as a remembered night and pass unseen between two watches.

name: Nocturne Prompt
description: Prompt a dreaming ally with a remembered cue so the ally wakes ready to act.

name: Nocturne Mending
description: Mend a mind trapped in a hostile dream by laying the true waking memory over it.

name: Nocturne Haze
description: Spread a dreamlike haze of remembered scenes over the foe until waking and dreaming blur.

name: Nocturne Replay
description: Replay a remembered night in the mind to find the one detail that did not belong.

name: Nocturne Lance
description: Drive a lance of dream-made memory through the foe's waking guard.

name: Nocturne Ward
description: Hold a ward in which no dream or false memory laid on the mind can take.

name: Nocturne Seal
description: Seal a foe's waking recall behind a dream so the foe cannot reach it until the dream is broken.

name: Nocturne Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of remembered night before the mind and return a probe to the one who sent it.

name: Remembered Dream
description: streams: Memory + Dream; make a remembered dream into a waking world and hold the foe in it so that every blow the foe strikes falls on the foe's own recollections.
